rationale: The current translations preserve falsity without automatically asserting every legal element.
The definition includes fish and shellfish; 見合わせる conveys a temporary postponement or refraining.
Speed competition is distinguished from broader 競争.
Physical resonance and figurative response to ideas are distinguished.
Discussion aimed at agreement is not presented as an agreement already reached.
An agreement is distinguished from the specific international-law term 条約.
Mental state and attained level of mastery/awareness are accurately represented.
Temple/shrine precinct is distinguished from an approach path.
Describe the university as a leading force in athletics rather than merely having strong athletes.
Neutral definitions and examples require no linguistic change.
School subject is distinguished from a specific course/subject unit.
Lessons learned from experience are conveyed naturally.
